invariants.statement: Every candidate HTML, CSS, JavaScript, image, API response and business mutation is same-origin; runtime remote requests and effects are zero.
acceptance_obligations: Browser network evidence across desktop and mobile has zero nonlocal requests.
Shipped files contain no source-origin runtime references.

invariants.statement: Search, brand, availability and sort results are deterministic functions of query parameters and seeded product data.
acceptance_obligations: Equal query strings yield equal item order after reset and restart.
An impossible query renders zero cards and recovery controls.

invariants.statement: The server validates product, option and quantity and owns all cart add, update and remove transitions; invalid or foreign values persist nothing.
acceptance_obligations: Unknown options and quantities outside 1..20 are rejected.
Cart subtotals are recomputed from catalog prices rather than client input.

invariants.statement: Anonymous carts are isolated by a site-specific host-only local cookie and persist in walmart.sqlite3 across refresh and server restart until explicit reset.
acceptance_obligations: Two browser contexts never observe each other's carts.
One cart persists across refresh and restart and reset clears it deterministically.

invariants.statement: Checkout validates a five-digit ZIP and ends at review with place-order disabled; no order, payment method, email, message, receipt or external effect can be created.
acceptance_obligations: Empty or invalid ZIP shows inline validation and no review state.
Reviewed state has no enabled submission or payment control.

invariants.statement: Search no-results, empty cart, account boundary, help and HTTP 404 surfaces provide local recovery routes and preserve truthful status.
acceptance_obligations: Every boundary surface links to a reachable local page.

invariants.statement: Frozen controls expose visible labels, keyboard focus, Enter submission, Escape dismissal with focus restoration, and responsive layouts at 1440x900 and 390x844.
acceptance_obligations: Keyboard-only search and popover dismissal complete.
All frozen routes remain usable without horizontal page overflow at both viewports.
